\section{1. Purpose}




This module defines the weekly execution system for Alexander’s job-search roadmap.




The goal is not to maximize raw application volume. The goal is to run a controlled system that balances:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
portfolio proof
targeted applications
market feedback
follow-ups
interview preparation
material iteration
\end{mdcode}




Current strategic position:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
Unity WebGL / Real-Time 3D Developer
Technical Visualization + Technical Art
XR / Simulation-adjacent portfolio
C# + shaders + optimization + 3D pipeline
\end{mdcode}




\medskip\hrule\medskip




\section{2. Operating principle}




\subsection{2.1 Main rule}




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
Proof quality first, application volume second.
\end{mdcode}




Because the current market evidence shows:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
- many roles are senior;
- portfolio/reel proof matters;
- technical-art/rendering proof matters;
- LATAM remote exists but is narrow;
- WebGL/technical visualization is a differentiator;
- generic Unity roles are competitive and often game/mobile-heavy.
\end{mdcode}




\subsection{2.2 Weekly loop}




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
1. Search
2. Score
3. Tailor
4. Apply
5. Follow up
6. Track
7. Review
8. Improve materials
\end{mdcode}




This loop repeats weekly.




\medskip\hrule\medskip

\section{4. Weekly schedule}




\subsection{4.1 Monday — search and score}




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
Goal:
Build the week’s candidate opportunity list.
\end{mdcode}




Tasks:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
[ ] Search primary role terms.
[ ] Capture 10–20 postings.
[ ] Reject obvious mismatches.
[ ] Score remaining roles.
[ ] Select 5–12 target applications.
[ ] Assign CV variant.
[ ] Assign portfolio/GitHub links.
\end{mdcode}




Primary search terms:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
Unity WebGL Developer remote
Unity Technical Artist remote
Unity Developer LATAM remote
Real-Time 3D Developer remote
Interactive 3D Developer remote
Technical Visualization Unity remote
\end{mdcode}




Output:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
weekly_target_roles.csv or tracker rows updated
\end{mdcode}




\medskip\hrule\medskip




\subsection{4.2 Tuesday — portfolio/material production}




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
Goal:
Improve proof before sending applications.
\end{mdcode}




Tasks:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
[ ] Improve TwinSight demo/media.
[ ] Update case-study section.
[ ] Add one screenshot or diagram.
[ ] Improve GitHub README.
[ ] Update LinkedIn Featured if needed.
[ ] Prepare role-specific CV variant.
\end{mdcode}




Priority order:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
1. 90-second demo
2. TwinSight case study
3. GitHub README
4. LinkedIn Featured
5. ArtStation breakdown
\end{mdcode}




Output:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
one public material improvement
\end{mdcode}




\medskip\hrule\medskip




\subsection{4.3 Wednesday — tailored applications}




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
Goal:
Submit the strongest applications.
\end{mdcode}




Tasks:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
[ ] Apply to Priority A roles.
[ ] Apply to strong Priority B roles.
[ ] Use tailored CV variant.
[ ] Include correct portfolio link.
[ ] Include GitHub link when technically relevant.
[ ] Add short cover note if field exists.
[ ] Update tracker immediately.
\end{mdcode}




Application target:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
3–6 applications
\end{mdcode}




Output:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
tracker status = Applied
\end{mdcode}




\medskip\hrule\medskip




\subsection{4.4 Thursday — follow-ups and recruiter contact}




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
Goal:
Increase response probability.
\end{mdcode}




Tasks:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
[ ] Send follow-ups for applications older than 5–7 business days.
[ ] Connect with recruiters/hiring managers only for strong-fit roles.
[ ] Message companies where portfolio relevance is high.
[ ] Update tracker with follow-up status.
[ ] Save responses and objections.
\end{mdcode}




Follow-up target:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
3–8 follow-ups
\end{mdcode}




Output:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
tracker status = Follow-up sent
\end{mdcode}




\medskip\hrule\medskip

\section{9. Cover note workflow}




\subsection{9.1 When to write a note}




Write a note only if:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
the platform has a field,
the fit is Priority A/B,
and the note can mention specific overlap.
\end{mdcode}




\subsection{9.2 Note length}




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
50–120 words
\end{mdcode}




\subsection{9.3 Note formula}




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
1. Role fit
2. TwinSight evidence
3. Stack match
4. Remote/contractor availability if relevant
\end{mdcode}




\subsection{9.4 Example — Unity WebGL}




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
I’m applying because this role aligns closely with my Unity WebGL technical visualization work. My flagship project, TwinSight X500, is a browser-based 3D inspection prototype for drone assembly, built with Unity, C#, WebGL, URP, UI Toolkit and Blender. It includes component selection, exploded view, clipping tools, visual modes, CAD-to-realtime optimization and usability/workload evaluation.
\end{mdcode}




\subsection{9.5 Example — LATAM remote Unity}




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
I’m based in Colombia and available for remote LATAM or international contractor work. My strongest Unity project is TwinSight X500, a WebGL technical visualization prototype with C#, URP, UI Toolkit, Blender optimization, component interaction and usability evaluation.
\end{mdcode}

\section{13. Feedback loop}




\subsection{13.1 If no responses after 20 applications}




Check:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
[ ] portfolio link visible?
[ ] demo video strong?
[ ] CV headline too broad?
[ ] applying to too-senior roles?
[ ] remote eligibility unclear?
[ ] cover note weak?
[ ] GitHub README incomplete?
\end{mdcode}




\subsection{13.2 If responses but no interviews}




Check:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
[ ] CV experience gap too visible?
[ ] project description not business-relevant?
[ ] salary expectation mismatch?
[ ] English profile weak?
[ ] not enough commercial framing?
\end{mdcode}




\subsection{13.3 If interviews but no offers}




Check:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
[ ] interview defense weak?
[ ] AI-use answer unclear?
[ ] technical depth not defended?
[ ] coding test gap?
[ ] shader/rendering gap?
[ ] remote contractor concerns?
\end{mdcode}




\medskip\hrule\medskip




\section{14. Material improvement triggers}




\subsection{14.1 Improve CV if}




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text

\subsection{14.5 Improve interview answers if}

\section{17. Interview preparation loop}




\subsection{17.1 Weekly rehearsal}




Once per week, rehearse:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
Tell me about TwinSight.
Why Unity WebGL?
How did you optimize CAD?
What was your role?
How did you use AI?
Is it a digital twin?
What would you improve?
Why should we hire you despite limited formal experience?
\end{mdcode}




\subsection{17.2 Answer quality criteria}




Good answers are:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
specific
technical
honest
short
evidence-backed
not defensive
\end{mdcode}




Bad answers are:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
vague
overexplaining
self-deprecating
overclaiming
too academic
\end{mdcode}

\section{20. No-go rules}




Do not spend weekly application time on:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
roles that require relocation now
roles that require US/EU work authorization now
pure full-stack roles
pure 3D artist roles
senior AAA roles
unpaid internships unless strategically exceptional
unclear crypto/metaverse roles
roles with no relation to Unity/3D/technical visualization
\end{mdcode}




Do not keep researching indefinitely.




If the proof package is incomplete, work on proof.




\medskip\hrule\medskip




\section{21. Weekly done definition}




A week is successful if:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
[ ] at least 5 good roles were scored
[ ] at least 3–8 applications were sent, depending on readiness
[ ] tracker is updated
[ ] follow-ups were sent where due
[ ] one material asset improved
[ ] one weekly review was written
[ ] next week focus is defined
\end{mdcode}




A week is not successful if:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
many roles were browsed but none were tracked
applications were sent without scoring
materials were not improved
follow-ups were forgotten
no learning was extracted
\end{mdcode}




\medskip\hrule\medskip




\section{22. Monthly review}




At the end of each month, review:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
total applications
response rate
interview rate
best-performing role titles
worst-performing role titles
recurring requirements
portfolio gaps
salary/rate signals
remote eligibility patterns
countries/regions with traction
\end{mdcode}




\subsection{22.1 Monthly decision}




Choose one:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
continue same targeting
narrow to best role family
expand to adjacent role family
pause applications and improve materials
increase application volume
adjust salary expectations
\end{mdcode}
